version.changelog:
- Skill更名为“disk-keeper”，优化命名与一致性  
- 明确声明“零上传”“全本地”，添加 network: none 等权限限制  
- 增加 zh-CN 适用说明，强化中文本地化（locale 字段、新说明）  
- 优化权限与安全边界描述，显式禁止危险自动化（如 recycle --purge 必须手动）  
- 新增 _meta.json 元数据，移除 skill-card.md  
- 文档精简和结构优化，对部分命令及 PRO 订阅能力进行澄清与规划说明

llm.summary: The skill is a local disk-cleanup tool with no network behavior, but its full-disk metadata scans exceed its declared cache-only read scope and can store sensitive path information locally.

dimensions.detail: For a cleaner, deleting explicit cache and temp targets is proportionate, but full fixed-drive traversal and persisted metadata are broader than needed for the declared cache-only cleanup boundary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains a standard SKILL.md, README, metadata, and a self-contained Python script with no third-party dependency install or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The documentation discloses full-disk inventory features in places, but the frontmatter declares filesystem-read as allowlisted-cache-dirs-only and also claims not to read user privacy files; broad path and size enumeration is under-scoped against that declaration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The script creates scripts/disk_keeper_state and persists ledger, history, lessons, and clean manifests locally; this is disclosed and not a system backdoor, but ledger and manifest entries may include sensitive local paths.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Disk cleanup, cache cleanup, recycle-bin handling, and disk-space diagnostics fit the stated purpose, but doctor --deep, scan, and big enumerate fixed drives broadly rather than limiting reads to allowlisted cache directories.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if you are uncomfortable with a local tool listing large files and top-level directories across all fixed drives. Prefer running doctor and plan first, inspect generated state under scripts/disk_keeper_state, and avoid recycle --purge unless you intend to permanently empty the recycle bin.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language interface is expected for this package because SKILL.md declares locale zh-CN and says the skill is designed for Chinese users.
[T05] unexpected: The finding is supported: deep inventory and big-file commands start from each detected fixed-drive root and can enumerate accessible personal or system path metadata despite the cache-only read permission declaration.
